name: Scenario: level run
description: Loads a level and drives player 1 through it with the scenario-level-run driver: movement, jump, fire, special, melee, one forced death and a respawn, the level's own mechanics, and the exit, or a timeout with a progress figure. Utility Mod's disableEnemySpawn is off for the run. survey=true scans the level instead of driving it. The default level, Intro level 1, finishes in about 25 s with five enemies, a door, a ladder and a cage.

campaign.description: Campaign index, as go_to_level takes it

timeoutSec.description: Driving budget in seconds; the poll waits 600 s in all, so keep it under about 480

requireMechanics.description: Comma list of mechanic kinds the run must exercise, e.g. wormTunnel,zipline

survey.description: true to scan and report the level's layout and mechanics without driving
